source: Kaggle dataset by Kundan Sagar Bedmutha. The dataset page states the 25,000 rows were 'generated to simulate realistic online shopping behavior in the Indian market' -> SIMULATED. Downloaded via Kaggle's public (anonymous) endpoint - CC BY 4.0.
country_context: Simulated Indian online-shopping sessions, calendar year 2024.
business_domain: E-commerce customer sessions: visits, pages, cart, purchase, pricing, ratings
provenance: Explicitly generated/simulated by the uploader (not a real export). Categorical columns are pre-integer-encoded with no decode map shipped.
license: CC BY 4.0 (per the Kaggle dataset page)
citation: Kundan Sagar Bedmutha. Indian E-Commerce Customer Behavior and Purchase [Data set]. Kaggle (CC BY 4.0).
unsupported_tasks: churn - there is NO churn target; cart_abandoned is not churn and is excluded as leakage
real-world customer analytics - the data is simulated
training or influencing any production model
preprocessing: ml/preprocessing/india_customer_adapter.py (seed 42): select pre-decision features + target, drop leakage columns, dropna.
benchmark: scripts/run_india_customer_benchmark.py - standalone sklearn (logistic/RF/xgboost), stratified 75/25 split, seed 42. NOT registered as an MLModel, NOT wired into the Training Center. Results in benchmark_results.json.
known_limitations: SIMULATED - not real customer behaviour. Never combine its metrics with real Indian results.
Categorical columns are integer-coded with no shipped decode map.
Default-threshold precision/recall are poor due to class imbalance; ROC-AUC (~0.75) is the informative metric.
paper_usage: May appear only as a clearly-labelled SYNTHETIC_INDIAN_CONTEXT demonstration of purchase-prediction; never in the real-world Indian tables, never averaged with real results.
